business_summary: Beijing Andawell Science & Technology Co., Ltd. operates in aviation industry in the People's Republic of China. It engages in the development of airborne equipment; measurement, control, and support equipment; intelligent equipment; and industrial software, as well as provides aircraft maintenance solutions. The company also offers aviation seats, such as crash-resistant, mechanic, pilot, and operator seats, as well as passenger seats for transport aircraft and crew seats for helicopters; cabin equipment, including aircraft interior, integrated kitchen, integrated bathroom, cabin lighting, etc.; mechatronics products comprising side rail components, cargo loading systems, etc.; navigation systems that include radio altimeters, radio compasses, multi-mode combined navigation, backup displays, and ground proximity warning systems; and composite components comprising optoelectronic domes, aircraft fairings, UAV beams and wing structures, aerospace and ship structures, etc., as well as helicopter simulation training systems. In addition, it provides intelligent tool cabinets, tool carts, top loading vehicles, ground mission vehicles, etc. Further, the company offers various measurement, control, and support equipment, including simulation environment construction, product function verification, fault troubleshooting and positioning, health diagnosis and management, service support, and simulation training; equipment-level products, such as in-situ detection equipment, simulation and special test equipment, cable harness test system, generator drag system, and general automation test system; system integration products, which include helicopter accompanying support system, simulation training equipment, and LVC training equipment; and comprehensive solutions, such as avionics system joint test, large-scale data collection, and real-time data simulation. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.
business_summary_ko: Beijing Andawell Science & Technology Co., Ltd.는 중화인민공화국에서 항공 산업을 운영하고 있습니다. 항공 장비 개발에 참여하고 있습니다. 측정, 제어 및 지원 장비; 지능형 장비; 산업용 소프트웨어뿐 아니라 항공기 유지보수 솔루션도 제공합니다. 또한 이 회사는 충돌 방지용, 정비사용, 조종사용 및 운전자용 좌석과 같은 항공용 좌석뿐만 아니라 수송 항공기용 승객석 및 헬리콥터용 승무원용 좌석도 제공합니다. 항공기 내부, 통합 주방, 통합 욕실, 객실 조명 등을 포함한 객실 장비; 측면 레일 부품, 화물 적재 시스템 등을 포함하는 메카트로닉스 제품; 전파 고도계, 전파 나침반, 다중 모드 결합 내비게이션, 백업 디스플레이 및 지상 근접 경고 시스템을 포함하는 내비게이션 시스템; 광전자 돔, 항공기 페어링, UAV 빔 및 날개 구조물, 항공우주 및 선박 구조물 등으로 구성된 복합 부품과 헬리콥터 시뮬레이션 훈련 시스템 등이 있습니다. 또한 지능형 도구 캐비닛, 도구 카트, 탑 로딩 차량, 지상 임무 차량 등을 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 다양한 측정 도구를 제공합니다.
